name: Left At Home
source:
Freckles is left at home sick as their partner, Beads, goes out to buy them medication. 

[From [url=https://rodfireproductions.itch.io/left-at-home]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
雀斑病了，獨自待在家裡。伴侶珠珠出了門，去給雀斑買藥。
